les: Wat alles in ons water beland
kaps_punt: Waterbesoedeling: in die omgewing, kan baie dinge meng of oplos in water; water kan besoedel word deur: onoplosbare stowwe, soos olie, plastiek, bande, blikkies, glas, toiletafval; oplosbare stowwe soos seep, kunsmis, insekdoders, sure en ander gifstowwe; lewende kieme van toiletafval veroorsaak wateroordraagbare siektes soos diarree

items.bewering: Iemand het dit weggegooi en die wind of die reën het dit tot by die water gebring.
items.blok: Hoe dinge in ons water beland
items.bron: Erie County (NY) stormwater page and Chesapeake Bay Program 'Stormwater Runoff': litter such as plastic bags is carried by stormwater into waterways; the lesson itself adds that waste is also thrown directly into rivers, so the example is not presented as the only route.

items.bewering: Reënwater loop oor landerye, strate en vullishope voordat dit in 'n rivier of 'n dam beland. Op pad tel dit grond, afval en ander stowwe op en dra dit saam.
items.blok: Hoe dinge in ons water beland
items.bron: National Geographic Education 'Runoff'; Chesapeake Bay Program 'Stormwater Runoff' (runoff carries trash, soil, fertiliser, pesticides and other pollutants from streets and farms into rivers).

items.bewering: Afval word soms ook reguit in 'n rivier gegooi.
items.blok: Hoe dinge in ons water beland
items.bron: NRDC 'Water Pollution: Everything You Need to Know' (direct dumping as a pollution source); general, hedged with 'soms'.

items.bewering: Toiletafval loop in die water in waar 'n rioolpyp lek of oorloop.
items.blok: Hoe dinge in ons water beland
items.bron: The Conversation, 'Sewage leaks put South Africa's freshwater at risk' and 'South Africa's sewage crisis: official reports don't include millions of litres of leaking wastewater'; SciELO SA, Hartbeespoort Dam nutrient study (leaking sewers as a source).

items.bewering: Ons noem dit besoedeling wanneer stowwe of kieme so in water beland en skade doen.
items.blok: Hoe dinge in ons water beland
items.bron: Britannica, 'Pollution': the addition of any substance or energy to the environment faster than it can be rendered harmless; harm to wildlife and health.

items.bewering: Die eerste soort is onoplosbare stowwe. Hulle los nie in water op nie. Hulle bly as stukke of as 'n laag in die water, en jy kan hulle gewoonlik sien.
items.blok: Stukke en lae wat jy kan sien
items.bron: Definition of insoluble matter; consistent with NOAA oil and marine debris pages. 'Die eerste/tweede/derde soort' are ordinals of the lesson's own grouping, not superlatives.

items.bewering: Olie meng nie met water nie en vorm 'n laag wat gewoonlik bo-op die water lê.
items.blok: Stukke en lae wat jy kan sien
items.bron: NOAA Office of Response and Restoration, 'Oil Spills at the Water Surface' and 'Oil Spills in Rivers'; Washington State 'Oil Spills 101: non-floating oils'. Most oils float; some heavy oils sink, which 'gewoonlik' correctly allows for.

items.bewering: Plastiek breek mettertyd in al kleiner stukkies op, maar dit verdwyn nie.
items.blok: Stukke en lae wat jy kan sien
items.bron: NOAA Marine Debris Program (plastic fragments into microplastics that persist); Fauna & Flora, 'How does plastic pollution affect marine life?'.

items.bewering: Visse, voëls en skilpaaie kan plastiek insluk of daarin vasraak.
items.blok: Stukke en lae wat jy kan sien
items.bron: NOAA Marine Debris Program, 'Ingestion'; US Department of the Interior, 'Marine Debris Impacts' (entanglement of seabirds and all six US sea turtle species); ICES Journal of Marine Science review on plastic and marine turtles.

items.bewering: Ou bande, blikkies en stukkende glas bly as harde stukke in die water.
items.blok: Stukke en lae wat jy kan sien
items.bron: NOAA Marine Debris Program (tyres, metal and glass as persistent debris); these materials are insoluble in water.

items.bewering: By toiletafval is dit die vaste afval self wat nie oplos nie en in die water bly.
items.blok: Stukke en lae wat jy kan sien
items.bron: Indiana Department of Health, 'Diseases Involving Sewage'; faecal solids are suspended, not dissolved, matter. The sentence limits itself to the solid part, which is accurate.

items.bewering: Die tweede soort is oplosbare stowwe soos seep en kunsmis.
items.blok: Gif wat jy nie kan sien nie
items.bron: ScienceDirect Topics, 'Sodium stearate' and NCEA soaps notes (soap dissolves in water, forming micelles); UC IPM, 'Urban Pesticides, Fertilizers, and Water Quality' (dissolved fertiliser in runoff).

items.bewering: Sure, party insekdoders en ander gifstowwe is ook oplosbaar.
items.blok: Gif wat jy nie kan sien nie
items.bron: Texas A&M AgriLife B-6050 'Pesticide Properties That Affect Water Quality' and USGS 'Pesticides and Water Quality' (solubility varies; some insecticides such as organophosphates are highly water-soluble, so 'party' is right); acid mine drainage literature (SciELO SA, 'The impact of acid mine drainage in South Africa') for dissolved acids. Read as naming soluble poisons, not as a claim that every poison dissolves.

items.bewering: Al hierdie stowwe los in die water op en versprei deur die water. Jy kan hulle dan gewoonlik nie meer sien nie. Water kan dus helder en skoon lyk en steeds besoedel wees.
items.blok: Gif wat jy nie kan sien nie
items.bron: USGS 'Pesticides and Water Quality'; NRDC water pollution explainer (dissolved contaminants are generally invisible; clear water can be contaminated). 'Gewoonlik' covers coloured solutions.

items.bewering: Jy het ook al geleer dat 'n sif, filtreerpapier of 'n lap nie 'n opgeloste stof uit water kan haal nie.
items.blok: Gif wat jy nie kan sien nie
items.bron: General chemistry of solutions: dissolved particles pass through filter paper; separation needs evaporation or reverse osmosis (e.g. LifeSaver bottle article noting filters do not remove salt). The 'jy het al geleer' framing is curricular, not checkable.

items.bewering: Gifstowwe en sure kan plante en diere in die water beseer of doodmaak.
items.blok: Gif wat jy nie kan sien nie
items.bron: SciELO SA, 'The impact of acid mine drainage in South Africa' (Tweelopiespruit downgraded to unable to support normal aquatic life); USGS and Beyond Pesticides on insecticide toxicity to fish.

items.bewering: Mense kan siek word as hulle sulke water drink.
items.blok: Gif wat jy nie kan sien nie
items.bron: WHO fact sheet 'Drinking-water' (chemical contamination of drinking water as a health risk); Business and Human Rights Centre report on acid mine drainage and water sources in South Africa.

items.bewering: Kunsmis gee plante stowwe wat hulle nodig het om goed te groei, en tog besoedel dit water.
items.blok: Kunsmis laat waterplante te vinnig groei
items.bron: SciELO SA, 'Increasing nutrient influx trends and remediation options at Hartbeespoort Dam' (nitrogen and phosphorus from runoff act as fertiliser in the dam); Chesapeake Bay Program.

items.bewering: Reën spoel opgeloste kunsmis van landerye en tuine af na riviere en damme.
items.blok: Kunsmis laat waterplante te vinnig groei
items.bron: National Geographic Education 'Runoff' (rain and irrigation drain fertilisers into water bodies); UC IPM on garden fertiliser runoff.

items.bewering: In die water laat dit alge en waterplante veel te vinnig groei. Hulle kan dan 'n dam of 'n stil stuk rivier toegroei.
items.blok: Kunsmis laat waterplante te vinnig groei
items.bron: ScienceDirect, 'The phytoremediation potential of water hyacinth: a case study from Hartbeespoort Dam' and ResearchGate, 'The role of eutrophication in the biological control of water hyacinth in South Africa' (excess nutrients drive algal blooms and water hyacinth mats covering dams).

items.bewering: Kieme is nie 'n stof wat oplos of nie oplos nie, maar baie klein lewende dinge.
items.blok: Kieme uit toiletafval
items.bron: Britannica Kids, 'microorganisms' (living things too small to see; the disease-causing ones are called germs). Whether viruses are alive is debated, but the lesson makes no claim about every germ, and the living-germs framing follows CAPS's own wording 'lewende kieme'.

items.bewering: Toiletafval kan lewende kieme dra.
items.blok: Kieme uit toiletafval
items.bron: WHO fact sheet 'Drinking-water' (water contaminated with human faeces from sewage, septic tanks and latrines transmits diarrhoea, cholera, typhoid); Daily Maverick 2026 on E. coli in SA rivers.

items.bewering: Kieme is te klein om met jou oë te sien. Water kan dus skoon lyk en tog kieme dra.
items.blok: Kieme uit toiletafval
items.bron: Britannica Kids 'microorganisms'; NCBI Bookshelf box 'What's a microbe?' (too small to be seen with the naked eye).

items.bewering: Iemand kan 'n wateroordraagbare siekte soos diarree kry deur sulke water te drink.
items.blok: Kieme uit toiletafval
items.bron: WHO fact sheets 'Diarrhoeal disease' and 'Drinking-water' (contaminated drinking water transmits diarrhoea; about 505 000 diarrhoeal deaths a year).

items.bewering: So 'n siekte kry 'n mens deur water te drink of te gebruik waarin iets is wat mense siek maak.
items.blok: Kieme uit toiletafval
items.bron: CDC, 'About Waterborne Disease Surveillance' (waterborne illness is caused by germs, chemicals or toxins in water that is swallowed, inhaled or touches the body), so the broad 'iets' and 'drink of gebruik' match the CDC definition.

items.bewering: Nie alle diarree kom van kieme in water nie, maar besoedelde water is een manier waarop mense dit kry.
items.blok: Kieme uit toiletafval
items.bron: WHO fact sheet 'Diarrhoeal disease' (spread through contaminated food, drinking water, or from person to person).

items.bewering: Onoplosbare stowwe bly as stukke of as 'n laag wat jy gewoonlik kan sien.
items.blok: Drie soorte besoedeling in water
items.bron: Same as the block 'Stukke en lae wat jy kan sien' (NOAA oil and marine debris pages).

items.bewering: Oplosbare stowwe los op en jy kan hulle gewoonlik nie sien nie.
items.blok: Drie soorte besoedeling in water
items.bron: Same as the block 'Gif wat jy nie kan sien nie' (USGS; NRDC).

items.bewering: Kieme is lewende dinge wat te klein is om te sien en mense siek kan maak.
items.blok: Drie soorte besoedeling in water
items.bron: Britannica Kids 'microorganisms'; WHO 'Diarrhoeal disease'. 'Kan' avoids a claim about every germ.

items.bewering: besoedeling: Iets skadeliks wat in die omgewing beland, soos stowwe of kieme in water, lug of grond.
items.blok: besoedeling
items.bron: Britannica, 'Pollution' (substances added to air, water or land that are not rendered harmless). The entry names the harmful thing rather than the act; English and Afrikaans dictionaries accept 'pollution' for the contaminants themselves as well as the process, so it is not false.

items.bewering: oplosbaar: Iets wat in water kan oplos, soos suiker en sout.
items.blok: oplosbaar
items.bron: Sucrose and sodium chloride are both highly water-soluble (standard chemistry references; salt-water filtration sources above).

items.bewering: onoplosbaar: Iets wat nie in water oplos nie, soos sand.
items.blok: onoplosbaar
items.bron: Sand (mainly silica/quartz) is insoluble in water; standard chemistry references.

items.bewering: kieme: Baie klein lewende dinge wat 'n mens siek kan maak.
items.blok: kieme
items.bron: Britannica Kids 'microorganisms'; Personal Care Assistant (eCampusOntario), 'What are Germs?'.

items.bewering: wateroordraagbare siekte: 'n Siekte wat 'n mens kan kry deur water te drink of te gebruik waarin iets is wat mense siek maak, soos kieme.
items.blok: wateroordraagbare siekte
items.bron: CDC, 'About Waterborne Disease Surveillance' (germs, chemicals or toxins; swallowing, inhaling or contact). Some narrower definitions (UNDRR) limit it to pathogens, but the entry names germs as its example and is correct under the CDC usage.

items.bewering: kunsmis: 'n Stof wat mense by grond voeg sodat plante beter groei.
items.blok: kunsmis
items.bron: UC IPM, 'Urban Pesticides, Fertilizers, and Water Quality'; standard definition of fertiliser.

items.bewering: insekdoder: 'n Middel wat mense gebruik om insekte dood te maak.
items.blok: insekdoder
items.bron: FAO, 'Pesticides as water pollutants'; standard definition of insecticide.

items.bewering: gifstof: 'n Stof wat 'n lewende ding siek kan maak of kan doodmaak.
items.blok: gifstof
items.bron: Standard definition of a poison/toxic substance; consistent with the acid mine drainage and pesticide toxicity sources above.

opsomming: Every claim holds against sources (NOAA, WHO, CDC, USGS, SA sewage and Hartbeespoort eutrophication studies); the lesson has no superlatives and no analogies, and its hedges ('gewoonlik', 'party', 'kan') are exactly the ones the sources need.
